text:
Violent with harmony, in the tone of the undertow,

the chorus of the seven provinces arrives,

seven adolescent faces

at the seven windows

of the stars of Autonomy.

They sing. The childhood of the Homeland sings with them,

dripping the first milk from its lips;

the first blond light descends from the stars,

sewing the button of the ear into the cornfields;

the chorus of the provinces dances,

in the republican classroom.

But they dance upon the grass

blue with fantasy,

upon Miranda's sky

pierced by masts while the squadron sails.


The Guayanese word

is not in the chorus of the seven nymphs,

and in them they reverse the course of the sky

and sail eastward like the Seven Sisters;

and there they see the miracle of the Earth:

on one side, virgin gold lays down a yellow strip,

toward the North, on the other side,

the Eastern Pampas, red with Reconquest,

and in the middle a blue river,

and there they see themselves reflected and nest in its center.

And so the river became its strip of sky

that presides over the dance of the seven provinces.

translation.title: Chorus of the Provinces
translation.editorial_note: The translation retains Venezuelan referents including Miranda, Guayana, the Eastern Pampas, and the Seven Sisters.
